## Month Close

A month issued at close. `totals` (`containsMany(ClosedTotal)`: `account`, `debitMinor`, `creditMinor`) is stored, copied from the live Month Totals card, so the financial statements read one small card per month instead of re-adding every document. Other fields: `month` (YYYY-MM), `status` (draft, closed), `closedBy`; computed `through`, `fromDate`, `debitMinor`, `creditMinor`.

The checklist reads `upTo` (every Month Close through this month) and `reconciliations` (Bank Reconciliations dated in this month). `checks` lists pass or FAIL lines: the month balances; accounts 1000 and 2100 are reconciled with no difference; Landed cost clearing (1230) and Opening balance equity (3900) net to zero. `ready` is true when every check passes.

```ts
import { MonthClose } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-close';
```

A draft is created by Month Totals' `issue` operation. Trial Balance, Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, the aging reports and the registers all read stored Month Close totals.

### Operations
- `post`: on a draft, asserts there are totals, none negative, and debits equal credits; sets `status` to closed and stamps `closedBy`. The checklist is advisory and is not asserted.
- `reconcile`: creates a draft Bank Reconciliation from `account`, `side`, `statementDate`, `endingBalanceMinor` and `outstanding`.

### Non-goals
The reconciled accounts and the zero-balance accounts in the checklist are fixed account codes, not configuration.

### Example
`MonthClose/2025-12`, the closed month carrying the opening bills.
